purpose.summary: ORCR0030 is a batch COBOL program that aggregates and calculates medical claim (receipt) point totals broken down by diagnosis/treatment category for the ORCA JMA standard receipt software system. It processes insurance claim data, computing scores/points for various medical acts (prescriptions, examinations, surgery, etc.) and formats the results for receipt printing.

verdict.notes: The file is decoded as latin-1 but the comments contain Japanese text (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), which appears garbled in the latin-1 rendering. This is a large, well-documented production program from the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The revision history is extensive (2000–2006+), confirming production maturity. No COMP-3 is unusual for a numeric-heavy billing program but may reflect GnuCOBOL conventions or deliberate choice.
